reaction: I was surprised that the inspection also completed the final combination; the grains' erosion gives their journey a clear consequence.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the dense knot with the cold cloud was most worthwhile: it connected the old pillars' surviving clumps to a new generation of stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: Carrying the dust outward was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though it set up the more interesting outcome.

surprise.text: Hot outer gas gradually eroded many of the carried dust grains, returning their material to the gas.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the combinations followed the chapter's stated paths for the clumps and dust.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in following how the surviving material changes again, especially after seeing the clumps form new stars and the dust take different paths.
